**Finding: Compliant (preferred level).**

Section 18 (Insurance) already satisfies every preferred element:

| Element | Where met |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M per occurrence | § 18.1 |
| CGL USD 2M aggregate | § 18.1 |
| Professional E&O USD 2M | § 18.1 |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (Customer Data) | § 18.1 — granted unconditionally, so it covers Vendor's processing |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | § 18.1 |
| Certificates on request | § 18.2 |

Section 18 also adds terms in our favour (employer's liability, primary coverage, notice of cancellation/material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities). No redline proposed.
